purpose: Teach: 兵役/根絶/敵意/施政/余命/群集/沈下/借款

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、戦時兵役関連の歴史的犯罪を警察、調査されてますね
lines.en: The police have been investigating the historical crimes related to wartime military service in this case, haven't they?
lines.style: Thoughtful, observational tone. Careful phrasing—genuinely curious, not challenging. Slight pause before the final phrase as though considering the weight of the topic.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、薬物の根絶を目標に活動を続けます
lines.en: The police will continue our efforts with drug eradication as our goal.
lines.style: Official but measured. Clear, direct delivery. Professional authority tempered with quiet purpose. Steady eye contact.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、被害者への敵意を扇動した発言を警察、注視されてますね
lines.en: In this case, the police have been monitoring statements that incited hostility toward the victims, correct?
lines.style: Careful, intellectual tone. Respectful but probing. Each phrase weighted. Slight hesitation before naming the harmful behavior, as if choosing words with precision.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、地方自治体の施政との連携を強化します
lines.en: We're strengthening our coordination with local government bodies on policy implementation.
lines.style: Formal, declarative. Confident delivery without arrogance. The tone of someone explaining institutional commitment. Measured pace.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、重病の容疑者の余命を警察、配慮されてますね
lines.en: The police are taking into account the terminal diagnosis of the suspect in this case, aren't they?
lines.style: Gentle but serious. Acknowledging human complexity within procedural responsibility. Lower register, respectful tone. No judgment in the voice.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、群集事故防止のため警備を厚くします
lines.en: We're increasing security presence to prevent crowd-related accidents.
lines.style: Practical, solution-focused delivery. Professional authority. Clear and direct without being cold. The voice of someone managing risk with care.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、地盤沈下による事故対応を警察、なさってますね
lines.en: The police are handling accident response related to ground subsidence in this case, yes?
lines.style: Observational, methodical. Quieter intensity—acknowledging the technical complexity. Respectful of the officer's expertise. No rising inflection on the question.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、不正借款詐欺の事案も捜査します
lines.en: We're also investigating cases of illegal loan fraud schemes.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact, focused. Completion of a statement—brief, confident. The voice of breadth of responsibility. No softening.
